verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const p="lib/nurture/runner.ts";if(!fs.existsSync(p)){console.error("SCAN-732: missing "+p);process.exit(79)}const s=fs.readFileSync(p,"utf8");const a=s.indexOf("runDueNurture");const b=s.indexOf(".limit(",a);if(a<0||b<0){console.error("SCAN-732: due query not found");process.exit(79)}const q=s.slice(a,b);const filtered=/\.in\(\s*.sequence_id|nurture_sequences!inner|nurture_sequences\.enabled/.test(q);if(!filtered){console.error("SCAN-732: the nurture due query still selects enrollments from paused sequences ahead of everything else, so once a paused sequence has limit or more due rows every run skips them all and every enabled sequence stalls while the cron reports ok.");process.exit(1)}'

append.detail: runDueNurture reads enabled sequence ids first and scopes the due query with in(sequence_id); a transient gate skip pushes next_run_at back 15 minutes; route header corrected.
